verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs describe paying vendors end-to-end through Bill Pay, including choosing a payment method, with "unlimited free same-day ACH and international wires for bill payments" plus RTP instant payments. Domestic ACH vendor payments are clearly covered. Domestic wires are not explicitly named, and no independent or hands-on report corroborates the payment rails. missing for 10: explicit documentation of domestic wire payments to vendors, detailed docs on ACH/wire payment-method mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can send domestic ACH and wire payments to vendors

citations.quote: Unlimited free same-day ACH and international wires for bill payments
Create approved bills via the API, attach documents, choose a payment method, and pay vendors end-to-end
Instant payments via RTP. Vendors get paid 2 days faster.
